correctness.rationale: Direct independent symbolic expansion of the asserted 3x3 modal matrix gives a1=(12q+11)/10, a2=(84q²+475q+690)/400 and a3=(80q³+862q²+98949q+1155)/8000, each positive for every q>=0. H=a1a2−a3=(1936q³+12386q²−71939q+14025)/8000. Signs H(0)>0,H(1)<0,H(4)>0, together with Descartes at most two positive roots, give one unstable q interval strictly between 0 and 4 containing q=1 only among Neumann squares. Cubic Routh–Hurwitz then gives exactly one unstable nonreal conjugate pair at mode k=1, all other discrete modes stable, and no nonnegative real root for any continuous q. Independent high-precision root checks gave q≈0.2022200709 and 3.5347727606. The conclusion concerns local linear modes, not nonlinear oscillating attractors.
